nodes.summary: For a polynomial $p$ with rational coefficients, $A_p$ is the set of rational numbers $p(n) + 1/n$, where $n$ ranges over the positive integers.
nodes.title: Polynomial values plus reciprocals

nodes.summary: For every polynomial $p$ with rational coefficients and positive leading coefficient, let $A_p$ be the set of rational numbers $p(n) + 1/n$, where $n$ ranges over the positive integers. Then $A_p$ is strongly complete: for every finite set $B$ of rational numbers there is an integer $N_0$ such that every integer $m \ge N_0$ is the sum of the elements of some finite subset of $A_p \setminus B$.
nodes.title: Strong completeness of polynomial values plus reciprocals (Erdős Problem 351)

nodes.summary: This is the proposition that for every polynomial $p$ with rational coefficients and positive leading coefficient, the set $A_p$ of rational numbers $p(n) + 1/n$, where $n$ ranges over the positive integers, is strongly complete.
nodes.title: The strong completeness statement of Erdős Problem 351

nodes.summary: A set $A$ of rational numbers is strongly complete when, for every finite set $B$ of rational numbers, there is an integer $N_0$ such that every integer $m \ge N_0$ is the sum of the elements of some finite subset of $A \setminus B$.
nodes.title: Strongly complete sets of rationals

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
